scope: Simplify existing image/text workspace and detail review. No new stitching capability, machine settings or automatic corrections.
changes: Existing start choices and Edit / Check stitches / Save and download workflow retained, not rebuilt.
Width and height together, proportional resize controls retained, both canvas dimensions echoed beneath the picture with empty-margin explanation.
Background, Thread colours and Picture details open existing controls directly with Back to size; remaining topics stay under Expert settings.
Same detail-review crops shown before descriptions, with Your picture / Before stitching labels and plain questions. No fabricated fix or approval buttons.
Optional AI help and older detail tools open only on request, not automatically through the explanation preference. Safety blockers remain visible.
Native text panel made more compact; nominal font size remains separate from measured finished width/height. No automatic text shrinking.
Image download failures shown inside the workspace, with a grouped summary and every server issue location retained. The exact existing checked URL is fetched; native download controller unchanged.
Pending image downloads cannot return a file after an edit invalidates their request. No automatic retry or safety bypass.

export_readback.result: Identical decoded stitch commands before/after for all six downloads; not just header or file-size comparison.

verification.syntax: Node syntax checks passed for workflow.js, workspace-ui.js, preparation.js, design-review.js and settings.js.
verification.static_audit: 89 existing findings remain: 88 literal-button action heuristics and 1 textarea resize heuristic; same totals as previous audit. Not a clean full-software audit.
verification.legacy_browser_commands: The two premium-ui.json legacy scripts write into forbidden outputs/. Not run; dedicated synthetic browser scripts substitute for this scope.
verification.screenshots: Before/after start, image edit, check, download, text edit, narrow and dark; after background, colours, picture review, Expert and download refusal in .simple-ui-evidence/.
verification.scope_note: No novice participant test or real sew-out; ease of use and physical accuracy are not certified. AI remains off in the customer app.
verification.browser_simple_editor: PASS before/after screenshots; image/text essentials fit 1366x768; direct topics; same controls/options; resize and Undo; keyboard; 390px reflow; dark/reduced motion; grouped export refusal, all locations, real nonempty download, offline and stale-response suppression.
verification.browser_design_review: PASS with synthetic AI only: unchanged control, three removed details, consent/cache, offline, stale review, narrow/dark/reduced motion.

decisions: Reuse existing palette, icons, options, history and native selects; no new theme or duplicate settings owner.

UI-only GET handling is now allowed in workflow.js specifically for the existing image download link. Updated the old blanket no-fetch test to require exactly that GET, no method override, no second generation/approval API, and stale-response protection.
No garment-placement chooser or unified text/image library added: these require separate data integration, not decorative controls.
No new repairs, per-region acceptance state, font capabilities or machine-safety guarantees introduced.
